scenes.description: A dandelion seed puff and a light cloud-like pancake floating weightlessly in the air, airy pastel colours.
A fork lifts a tender piece of sponge cake with a visibly fine airy interior.
A seated person supports their head with one hand, looking unfocused amid soft swirling shapes.

scenes.sense: Lacking seriousness or a firm plan
scenes.description: A person looks toward a window instead of an unfinished cardboard model while a dog watches beside them.
